en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a large, ornate railway station building with towers and arched windows. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand in the open square in front of the station. Trees and a streetlamp line the left side. The caption at the top reads "Pécs — Pályaudvar". The reverse side is blank except for printed dividing lines, a circular stamp mark, and publisher information along the left edge.
